comparison.objective: Form, tighten, and release an overhand knot in a cord.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable loop formation, threading, bimanual tensioning, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Released knot remains intact five seconds and, for full credit, previously passes the 117 cm suspended-span check.
comparison.reason: Deformable knot tying tests topology and tension management, unlike rigid damper adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
